From idea to production

Turn your vision into a working application

Good software starts with a conversation. Here's how we move your idea forward, together.

01 —

Understand.

We map your users, current tools, and business goals. You get a shared understanding of the problem to solve.

02 —

Shape.

We define the scope, user flows, data structure, and integration needs. Milestones and estimates are discussed before building.

03 —

Build.

We develop in agreed stages, review progress with you, and test the workflows that matter to your business.

04 —

Launch & evolve.

We plan deployment, handover, and documentation with you. Ongoing maintenance and future improvements are scoped together.

Why Ubernyx

Technology with
a business purpose.

You bring the business knowledge. We translate it into software requirements, clear interfaces, and connected workflows. You stay involved in the decisions without needing to speak in code.

↗ Clear scope and priorities before development.

A little clarity

Before we start.

No technical background required.

Do I need a complete specification?

No. Start with the problem you want to solve, who the software is for, and the tools you use today. We can help turn that into a project scope.

Can the software connect to our existing tools?

We review the systems and data you want to connect, including available APIs and access requirements. That review helps determine what is feasible and what belongs in the scope.

How are pricing and timelines decided?

They depend on the agreed features, integrations, and complexity. Scope, milestones, estimates, and assumptions should be discussed before development starts.

What happens after launch?

Deployment, documentation, and handover are planned together. If you need maintenance or new features, we can discuss an ongoing arrangement as part of the project.
